2016.why: It drew about a third as many complaints as the average car in its first 3 years, most about lights.
2016.pln: about a third as many complaints as the average car
td: Lights
Walk around with the lights on: headlights, taillights, brake lights and turn signals.
Engine
Start it cold if you can. Listen for ticking or knocking, and watch for smoke, a rough idle or a check-engine light.
Electrical
Try every light, screen, window, lock and power feature, and watch the dash for warning lights.
Fuel system
Watch for hard starts, stalling, hesitation or a fuel smell.

2017.why: It drew somewhat fewer complaints than the average car in its first 3 years, most about airbags.
2017.pln: somewhat fewer complaints than the average car
td: Airbags
The airbag light should come on at start, then go out and stay out.
Electrical
Try every light, screen, window, lock and power feature, and watch the dash for warning lights.
Brakes
Brake firmly once at speed: it should stop straight, with no pulsing, grinding or brake warning light.
Seat belts
Every belt should latch and retract.
Engine
Start it cold if you can. Listen for ticking or knocking, and watch for smoke, a rough idle or a check-engine light.

2018.why: It drew about half as many complaints as the average car in its first 3 years, most about brakes.
2018.pln: about half as many complaints as the average car
td: Brakes
Brake firmly once at speed: it should stop straight, with no pulsing, grinding or brake warning light.
Shifting
From a stop and on the highway: no slipping, flaring revs, harsh or late shifts, or shudder.
Engine
Start it cold if you can. Listen for ticking or knocking, and watch for smoke, a rough idle or a check-engine light.
Body
Look underneath for rust, and check the doors, hood and hatch close and latch right.
Electrical
Try every light, screen, window, lock and power feature, and watch the dash for warning lights.

2019.why: It drew about a fifth as many complaints as the average car in its first 3 years, most about brakes.
2019.pln: about a fifth as many complaints as the average car
td: Brakes
Brake firmly once at speed: it should stop straight, with no pulsing, grinding or brake warning light.
Auto braking
Watch for sudden braking or collision warnings with nothing ahead.
Lane assist
Watch for false lane alerts or the wheel tugging on its own.
Electrical
Try every light, screen, window, lock and power feature, and watch the dash for warning lights.
Backup camera
Shift into reverse a few times: the camera should come on every time.

2020.pln: complaints only, too few sold to score
td: Electrical
Try every light, screen, window, lock and power feature, and watch the dash for warning lights.
Suspension
Drive over bumps: listen for clunks or rattles, and look for uneven tire wear.

2021.pln: complaints only, too few sold to score

It should accelerate and hold speed smoothly, with no surging; try the cruise control.
Suspension
Drive over bumps: listen for clunks or rattles, and look for uneven tire wear.
Airbags
The airbag light should come on at start, then go out and stay out.
Auto braking
Watch for sudden braking or collision warnings with nothing ahead.
